description: Legacy 1.0.8 release of WirelessBattery; upstream renamed the current application to BatteryHub in 1.1.0.
notes: Pinned legacy manifest for the original WirelessBattery 1.0.8 package. The upstream project renamed the application and executable to BatteryHub in v1.1.0.
This manifest intentionally stays on v1.0.8 because the newer release uses a different archive and executable. For current upstream releases, install batteryhub instead.
This manifest installs the vendor-provided portable ZIP. It does not run the Inno Setup installer.
Preferences are stored in HKCU\Software\WirelessBattery. The Start with Windows option writes an entry under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run.
